run_flux_control_pipeline: run the FluxControlPipeline to generate images from text prompts and control images
encode_flux_prompts: encode text prompts into CLIP and T5 embeddings for the Flux pipeline
prepare_flux_control_image: prepare a control image for conditioning the Flux pipeline generation
prepare_flux_latents: prepare latent variables with packing and image IDs for the Flux denoising loop
calculate_flux_shift: calculate the shift parameter for the FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler based on sequence length
